The silicone grips slide seamlessly onto each Joy-Con 2 controller, giving you a more secure, comfortable hold during long play sessions while also cushioning them against accidental drops. At the same time, the durable hard plastic console shell shields your Switch 2 from scratches, bumps, and everyday wear without adding bulk. The ShieldGrip maintains full functionality with a slim, form-fitting design that keeps every port, button, and feature fully accessible. Even better, it works flawlessly with the Switch 2 TV Dock, so you never have to remove it when switching from handheld play to the big screen.
